card.title: Drones for Deliveries
card.passage: Today, some companies are testing drones to deliver goods. Drones can fly over roads and rivers, and in this way they can reach places that are hard to get to by car. Companies hope that drones will help people living in mountain areas. However, drones can be affected by bad weather, so companies need to make sure they can fly safely.

bubbles.t: Let's go to Okinawa this summer!

panels.cap: On the day of the trip

card.start: One day, Mr. and Mrs. Sato were talking about their summer vacation.

steps.t: First, please read the passage silently for 20 seconds.
All right. Now, please read it aloud.
Now, I'll ask you four questions.
Number 1. According to the passage, how can drones reach places that are hard to get to by car?
Number 2. Now, please look at the pictures and describe the situation. You have 20 seconds to prepare. Your story should begin with the sentence on the card.
Now, please turn over the card and put it down.
Number 3. Some people say that families should spend more time together. What do you think about that?

points: and in this way / However, の前で区切る
内容のまとまりを意識して

q1.q: According to the passage, how can drones reach places that are hard to get to by car?
q1.ja: ドローンはどうやって車で行きにくい場所に届くことができますか。
model: By flying over roads and rivers.
points: in this way の前を答える

q2.ja: 3コマのイラストの話を、カードの最初の文から説明してください。
model: One day, Mr. and Mrs. Sato were talking about their summer vacation. Mrs. Sato said to her husband, "Let's go to Okinawa this summer!" A week later, Mr. Sato was booking plane tickets on his computer, and Mrs. Sato was packing a suitcase. On the day of the trip, they were at the airport. They found out that their flight had been canceled because of a typhoon.
points: 2人がそれぞれしていることを説明
過去完了(had been canceled)も使えると◎

q3.q: Some people say that families should spend more time together. What do you think about that?
q3.ja: 家族はもっと一緒に過ごすべきだという意見について、どう思いますか。
model: I agree. Spending time together helps family members understand each other. For example, they can talk about their problems during dinner.
I disagree. Many people are busy with work and school. It is more important for families to enjoy the time they have together.
points: I agree / I disagree で立場を

ek2_4.q: Today, many people buy things on the Internet. Do you think online shopping will become more popular in the future?
ek2_4.ja: 将来、ネットショッピングはもっと広まると思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → It is convenient because people can buy things at any time. Also, delivery services are getting faster.
model.no: No. → Many people want to see products before they buy them. They also enjoy shopping with their friends at stores.

ek2_4.q: These days, many people pay without cash. Do you think cash will disappear in the future?
ek2_4.ja: 将来、現金はなくなると思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Paying by smartphone is fast and easy. Stores can also save time because they do not need to count money.
model.no: No. → Some elderly people are not used to cashless payments. Cash is also useful when there is a power outage.

ek2_4.q: Today, robots are used in many places. Do you think more robots will work in stores and restaurants in the future?
ek2_4.ja: 将来、店やレストランで働くロボットは増えると思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Many stores do not have enough workers. Robots can do simple jobs such as carrying food.
model.no: No. → Many customers want to talk with real people. Robots are also too expensive for small stores.

ek2_4.q: In Japan, the number of elderly people is increasing. Do you think the government should do more to help them?
ek2_4.ja: 政府は高齢者をもっと支援すべきだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Many elderly people live alone and need help in their daily lives. The government should build more care facilities.
model.no: No. → Families and local communities can support elderly people. The government also needs money for young people.

ek2_4.q: These days, many people get news from social media. Do you think the information on social media is reliable?
ek2_4.ja: SNSの情報は信頼できると思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → People can get news quickly from people who are actually there. Many news companies also use social media.
model.no: No. → Anyone can post information on social media. Some of it is not true, so people need to be careful.

ek2_4.q: Today, many students take classes online. Do you think online classes are as good as classes at school?
ek2_4.ja: オンライン授業は学校の授業と同じくらい良いと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Students can watch the lessons again and again. They can also study at their own pace.
model.no: No. → It is difficult to ask teachers questions online. Students also need to make friends at school.

ek2_4.q: Many foreign tourists visit Japan. Do you think there should be more signs in foreign languages?
ek2_4.ja: 外国語の案内表示をもっと増やすべきだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Tourists often get lost in big stations. Signs in many languages will help them travel safely.
model.no: No. → Many tourists can use translation apps on their smartphones. Too many signs can be confusing.

ek2_4.q: Some people say that companies should let workers take longer vacations. Do you think this is a good idea?
ek2_4.ja: 会社は社員にもっと長い休暇を取らせるべきだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Workers can relax and come back with more energy. They can also spend more time with their families.
model.no: No. → If many workers take long vacations, the company may not be able to do its work. Customers may have problems.
